09f0abdfdcc9cc3038d147028c913c04958925d1.summary: A 2022 blog post by Pepe Berba, part 3 of a Linux persistence hunting series, covers three persistence methods: malicious systemd services, systemd timers and cron jobs. It explains where unit files and cron entries are placed and how to detect them with auditd, sysmon, auditbeat and osquery. It maps each method to MITRE ATT&CK techniques and notes detection gaps.
